idea-plugin.name: JSON Log Lens
idea-plugin.description:
Makes JSON log lines in the Run/Debug console readable. Every console line that is a complete JSON object is shown through a template of your choice, for example {time} {level} {#logger}[{logger}] {/logger}{msg}. All other lines stay as they are.
  • Fields by name, nested fields by path: {source.file}
  • Optional sections that only appear when a field is present: {#logger}...{/logger}
  • Tabs and line breaks: \t and \n
  • Live preview and an on/off switch in the settings
Configure it under Settings | Tools | JSON Log Lens.
